validation.blinding: Seal all available closed-loop model predictions and neutral analytical derivatives from the three reset previews before collecting any of the 45 shared native trajectories. No native state injection after reset. Preserve partial and stopped trajectories and availability counters.
validation.matched_effect: For each seed use all six matched analytical-versus-native relative slope errors (three resets, both symmetric radii). Error is abs(a-b)/max(abs(a),abs(b)); undefined for two zero slopes. All three seed medians must decrease strictly against the equal-budget control. A missing comparison cannot pass.
validation.h16: Reuse round 98 normalized seven-group H16 state MSE, original scales and acceptance rules. All fifteen aligned trajectory scores must be available in both arms in each seed; the late arm must strictly reduce each of the three seed medians.
validation.h32: Use every tools95.score95.score_cell gate, unchanged. Native target is the negative mean absolute departure from the native reset in ticks 1-32. Require all nine candidate cells to pass safety, completion, stable positive native slopes, both positive-step benefits, and analytical agreement with model and native at both radii with the 25% symmetric magnitude tolerance.
validation.interpretation: Report matched sensitivity improvement, H16 state and H32 all-nine separately. Preserve the round-98 promotion gates (H16 and H32 with verified inputs) and report separately whether all three outcomes hold. Neither training a new whole-body policy nor deploying it is part of this trial.
